name: Reformed Acolyte
body:
You are an adherent of a faith, or once were but have since renounced it.

Benefit: You gain a +1 trait bonus on Knowledge (local) and Knowledge (religion) checks, and one of these skills is always a class skill for you.

This bonus increases to +2 when dealing with specifics of a specific faith.
